---
title: "BBS and R Universe"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
# Use the package source in this checkout if possible, so changes to R/ show
# up without reinstalling
if (file.exists("DESCRIPTION") && requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
    pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE)
} else {
    library(biocUniTools)
}
config <- yaml::read_yaml("reports/config.yml")
summary_file <- file.path("reports", config$data_dir, "summary.rds")
has_data <- file.exists(summary_file)
if (has_data)
    s <- readRDS(summary_file)
```

Each row compares one Bioconductor branch and package type on `r config$platform`.
Workflows compare `R CMD build` on both; other
types compare `R CMD check`. NOTE is treated as OK; WARNING(S) are treated the
same. Select a type for its packages.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!has_data) {
    cat("No data yet. Run `biocUniTools::write_comparisons(\"reports/config.yml\")`.\n")
} else {
    cat(sprintf("Updated %s.\n", format(attr(s, "created"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")))
}
```

::: column-page
```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) summary_table(s, link_fmt = "reports/compare/%s-%s.html")
```
:::
